info.description: Ideogram's first vector model. It generates editable SVG artwork from a prompt with optional image references (POST /v2/svg/generate/ideogram-vector-1), and converts a raster image to SVG (POST /v2/svg/vectorize/ideogram-vector-1). Text to SVG costs $0.13, $0.16 and $0.20 per SVG at low, medium and high quality; with image references, high quality costs $0.32; image to SVG costs $0.10 per image. The stored price is the lowest text-to-SVG tier, low quality.

zh.description: Ideogram 的首个矢量模型。它可根据提示词（可选参考图）生成可编辑的 SVG 作品（POST /v2/svg/generate/ideogram-vector-1），也可将位图转换为 SVG（POST /v2/svg/vectorize/ideogram-vector-1）。文本生成 SVG 在低、中、高质量下分别为每个 SVG $0.13、$0.16、$0.20；带参考图时高质量为 $0.32；图片转 SVG 为每张 $0.10。记录的是文本生成 SVG 的最低档（低质量）。
